verdicts.critique: This is the colorless transparent bottle experiment in Table 1, reported at 150 °C for 6 h with 85% conversion and 51% yield (ID: 0d8b951c-a917-5116-858e-88ad67701879). Selectivity is not tabulated, but it is derivable as 51/85 × 100 = 60%.
